tagline: Paid to run from the Fox and paid to run with him — and he halves what you swing

featuredCards.title: Ginger snap
featuredCards.caption: Rewards him for being nowhere near his own sidekick — a card and a health for keeping his distance.

featuredCards.title: Working together
featuredCards.caption: And the opposite: stand beside the Fox and the turn keeps going. The deck pulls you both ways every turn.

featuredCards.title: Cookie cutter
featuredCards.caption: Cuts your number in half before it lands. The best defence in this deck is your own attack, ruined.

featuredCards.title: the way the cookie crumbles
featuredCards.caption: Burns the top of the deck to damage everyone in his zone and heal it straight back. A cookie for you, a cookie for him.
